# Client email templates

`emails/` holds one email-safe HTML file per client message and language (9 messages × EN/ES), generated by `emails/build_emails.py` from the approved copy in `docs/templates/client-messages.md`. Same layout as `email-booked-es.html`: tables + inline styles, max 600 px, Waoo pink button. Variables `{{...}}` are filled by MAIL-01. To change copy: edit the script, rerun `python3 docs/templates/html/emails/build_emails.py`, and keep `client-messages.md` in sync.
